article.story: NASHVILLE, Tenn. -- — Tyler Tanner scored 21 points and No. 15 Vanderbilt beat Eastern Illinois 96-50 on Tuesday night. Sebastian Williams-Adams scored 16 points, Ace Glass added 16 and Ant Brown 10 for Vanderbilt. Tanner Vogel's 16 points led Eastern Illinois. Vanderbilt (5-0) started slowly, shooting 1 for 8 from long distance, and that allowed Eastern Illinois (1-5) to build a 9-6 lead at 15:26 in the first half. Vanderbilt edged ahead 29-22 with 5:02 left in the half and then began to pull away. In the final 2:18 of the half, Vanderbilt went on an 8-0 run and led 43-26 at the break. Meanwhile, Eastern Illinois endured a scoring drought in the final 2:35 of the half. Vanderbilt scored 11 points early in the second half on a Berke Büyüktuncel layup, a Williams-Adams 3-pointer, a Tanner layup and 3-point make. The Commodores put on a shooting clinic in the second half, shooting 62.5% from distance and making 10 3-pointers. This was the first matchup between the Commodores and the Panthers. Eastern Illinois finished eighth in the Ohio Valley Conference last year, and hasn’t made the NCAA Tournament since 2001. Up next Eastern Illinois: At No. 10 Illinois on Friday. Vanderbilt: Hosts UCF on Friday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
